## Solver captcha

### captchaai — saldo $5, TERBUKTI tembus Turnstile
```
key    : ixvwhhocndcyyon2f1vbixds6ltuujnb
endpoint: https://ocr.captchaai.com/in.php  &  /res.php
```
```bash
# Turnstile
curl "https://ocr.captchaai.com/in.php?key=KEY&method=turnstile&sitekey=SITEKEY&pageurl=URL&json=1"
# polling
curl "https://ocr.captchaai.com/res.php?key=KEY&action=get&id=ID&json=1"
# cek saldo
curl "https://ocr.captchaai.com/res.php?key=KEY&action=getbalance&json=1"
```
Catatan: token reCAPTCHA **v3 Enterprise** (AllModels) DITOLAK walau token valid (skor rendah).

### DDoS-Guard — cadangan
```
key : JB1BY4C17D99TN-H1KL0DG8S3EM08SHW5K0XTPKR
src : https://my.ddos-guard.net/captcha/139272/keys/JB1BY4C17D99TN-.../common
```

## capbypass.pro — solver cadangan (TERUJI, saldo ~$1.99)
```
key      : cap_live_2a9c30a47d0bbdfde2f4470b61648b0b
API      : POST https://api.capbypass.pro/createTask
           POST https://api.capbypass.pro/getTaskResult   (poll tiap 2-3 s)
           POST https://api.capbypass.pro/getBalance      {"clientKey":...}
biaya    : ~$0.0006 per task
```

### Hasil tes (17 Nov)
| Tipe | Hasil |
|---|---|
| `ReCaptchaV3TaskProxyLess` | **OK, skor 0.9**, ~2 detik |
| `ReCaptchaV3EnterpriseTaskProxyLess` | **OK** (untuk AllModels) |
| `TurnstileTaskProxyLess` | **OK** — sitekey HEX `0x4AAAAAAF3EU-q7sNrfjP5Q`, token 773 char |
| `GeetestTaskProxyLess` | **OK** — pakai `captchaId`, bukan `websiteKey` |
| `CaptchaFoxTaskProxyLess` | **OK** — GMX `sk_vKdD8WGlPF5FKpRDs1U4qTuu6Jv0w`, ~1,6 s |
| `AntiAwsWafTaskProxyLess` | **OK** — amazon.com; aws.amazon.com gagal |
| `ReCaptchaV2TaskProxyLess` | **INACTIVE** di akun ini |

Tipe valid: ReCaptchaV2Task/ProxyLess, ReCaptchaV3Task/ProxyLess,
ReCaptchaV3EnterpriseTask/ProxyLess, TurnstileTask/ProxyLess,
HCaptchaTask/Proxyless, GeetestTaskProxyLess, CaptchaFoxTaskProxyLess,
AntiAwsWafTaskProxyLess, CloudflareTask.

### Bandingkan dengan captchaai
- captchaai: Turnstile OK, tapi token reCAPTCHA v3 **skor rendah** -> AllModels tolak.
- capbypass: skor **0.9** -> jauh lebih mungkin diterima. **Pakai capbypass untuk reCAPTCHA.**

### Catatan
- **WAJIB kirim `User-Agent`.** Tanpa UA -> `403 error code: 1010` (Cloudflare).
  Nilai bebas: `python-requests/2.34.2` maupun UA browser sama-sama lolos.
  `urllib` tanpa header UA = gagal; `requests` lolos karena punya UA default.
- Solusi Turnstile ada di `solution.token`; reCAPTCHA di `solution.gRecaptchaResponse`.
- **CaptchaFox ter-nested ganda**: `solution.solution.token` (bukan `solution.token`).
- **AntiAwsWaf** mengembalikan `token`, `cookie`, `captchaVoucher`, `userAgent`
  — keempatnya harus dipakai, bukan cuma token.
- Pakai `capsolve.py` (sudah jadi + teruji), bukan tulis curl manual.
- Geetest butuh `captchaId` (contoh `fcd636b4514bf7ac4143922550b3008b`).
- Error `ERROR_TASK_TYPE_INACTIVE` = tipe tidak aktif di akun.
- `ERROR_INVALID_TASK_DATA` = sitekey/data salah (bukan saldo habis).

## GMX (signup.gmx.com) — hasil uji 17 Nov
**Captcha:** CaptchaFox (`sk_vKdD8WGlPF5FKpRDs1U4qTuu6Jv0w`) + reCAPTCHA v3
(`6LdAZJIbAAAAAAhRV4Ojgba7ggroit4oKK6gYyZX`) sebagai cadangan.
**Status:** token CaptchaFox capbypass **berhasil dibuat** (68 char, `MAM_...`),
tapi signup lewat API **belum lolos** (403 Access Denied).

### Endpoint & format (dari main.js registrasi v8.38.0)
```
POST https://signup.gmx.com/account/email-registration
Content-Type: application/vnd.ui.mam.account.creation+json
cf-captcha-response: <token CaptchaFox>        <- token dikirim LEWAT HEADER, bukan body
Authorization: <accessToken>                    <- dari config halaman
X-CCGUID: <clientCredentialGuid>               <- dari config halaman
X-UI-APP / X-REQUEST-ID / Template-Name        <- wajib
body: {user:{givenName,familyName,gender,birthDate,address{...},credentials{password}},
       mailAccount:{email}, product:"FreeMail"}
```
Cek alias: `https://register-suggest.gmx.com/rest/email-alias/availability`
Validasi SMS: `POST {accountRestUrl}/validateMtan` {mobileNumber, confirmationCode}
Kirim SMS: `POST {accountRestUrl}/obligation` {mobileNumber}

### Kenapa 403 (belum selesai)
- `X-UI-APP` = `${APP_NAME}/${APP_VERSION}`, nilainya dinamis (tidak ada di HTML).
- Perlu `X-CCGUID` + `Authorization` dari config halaman -> `accessToken`
  (bukan `authToken`; regex lama salah nama).
- Belum dicoba: ambil `X-UI-APP` dari request asli browser (DevTools/Playwright).

### Catatan penting
- **Langkah terakhir minta nomor HP + kode SMS** ("Enter cellphone number").
  Tanpa nomor, akun mungkin tetap jadi tapi tanpa recovery. Perlu konfirmasi
  apakah langkah ini wajib atau bisa dilewati.
- CaptchaFox solusi ter-nested: `solution.solution.token`.
- Form-nya custom element (`pos-*`), tidak bisa diisi via tool browser biasa.
